title: Complete Buffer Replay
statement: Let $x,w,$ and $out$ be finite Boolean words, and let $p$ be an input-head position for $x$. Starting with the replay machine in its start control, its work tape storing $w$ with the head at cell $|w|$, and output $out$, after $2|w|+3$ steps it is halted, the head is at cell $|w|$, the buffer remains $w$, and the output is $out$ followed by $w$.
replaced: For every input word, input position, buffer $w$, and output prefix, running the replay machine from its start control at the buffer's right blank for $2|w| + 3$ steps appends exactly $w$ to the output and physically halts; the initial left move, full rewind, every emitted bit, and the halt are all charged.
